summary: Truck owner's liability for heroin found in vehicle; chargesheet names only Md. Dimpul as accused; no evidence linking appellant to narcotics; standard: possession must be conscious and voluntary; mere custody insufficient for conviction; impugned dismissal of writ petition reversed.
legal_provisions_cited: Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985 s.21(b)
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; appellant discharged.
